name: vertrag-oracle-reference
description: Drives the reference Dredd implementation so its output can be compared against vertrag's
_comment: Pinned exactly, never with a range. This package IS the expectation the Go
implementation is checked against, so a floating version would silently
redefine 'correct' on some future install. Bumping it is a deliberate act:
raise the version here, run the oracle, and deal with whatever diff appears.
